result.title: Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
result.summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object indicated by a click point in a ground or drone query image within a satellite reference image. Through a quantitative prompt-sensitivity evaluation, we find that existing CVOGL methods suffer from a prompt-disobeying overfitting problem: when the click point is moved or removed, their predictions barely respond, indicating that the models rely on spurious feature correlations rather than genuinely following the prompt semantics. We trace this behavior to the limited scale of the benchmark dataset, which contains only 4,343 prompt-object pairs per task, so that the models simply memorize the object associated with each scene instead of learning the true prompt-to-object correspondence. To address this, we propose two plug-and-play components. First, we construct the CVOGL-MO dataset by expanding the existing training and test sets with diverse multi-object annotations, mitigating the memorization that induces shortcut learning. Second, we propose the Cross-View Co-Scene Multi-Object Contrastive Loss (CVMCL), which enforces distinct feature representations for different click points within the same scene, compelling the model to follow prompt instructions. We further design a prompt-sensitivity evaluation protocol with prediction-shift metrics, providing the first quantitative measurement of prompt-following capability for CVOGL. Both components are architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing methods without any architectural modification. Experiments on three representative backbones show that our components substantially improve prompt-following accuracy on the new multi-object test sets and markedly increase prompt sensitivity. Our dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/Sunny-Fresher/CVOGL-MO.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究跨视角目标地理定位中的「提示不服从」过拟合现象，发现模型在点击点移动或移除时预测几乎不变，遂构建多目标数据集 CVOGL-MO 并提出跨视角同场景多目标对比损失，使同场景不同点击点获得区分性表示，同时设计提示敏感性评价指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「提示敏感性/预测漂移」诊断可用于核查 VLM 是否真正依赖所指定的视觉证据而非场景捷径，多目标对比监督也可能为提示条件下的证据筛选与表示区分提供线索；但任务本身是检索式定位，不涉及 latent 推理状态，需阅读原文判断可迁移性。
